@Test fun customSnoozeClockSurvivesRecreationWithoutAcknowledging() {
        val (_,e)=seed(due=FinalReminderService.localMillis(java.time.LocalDate.now(),0,0))
        full(e);tap("Напомнить снова");tap("+другое")
        recreateCurrent()
        ui.onAllNodesWithText("00").assertCountEquals(2)
        Assert.assertEquals(EventState.ACKNOWLEDGED,event(e)?.state)
        Assert.assertNotNull(event(e)?.acknowledgedAt)
        Assert.assertFalse(FinalAlarmSignalPlayer.isActive(e))
        closeAlarm()
        text("Выберите будущее время!")
        Assert.assertEquals(EventState.ACKNOWLEDGED,event(e)?.state)
        Assert.assertNotNull(event(e)?.acknowledgedAt)
        Assert.assertFalse(FinalAlarmSignalPlayer.isActive(e))
    }

@Test fun customClockDigitsDoNotSaveAndCloseRejectsPastTime() {
        val (_,e) = seed(due=FinalReminderService.localMillis(java.time.LocalDate.now(),0,0))
        full(e);tap("Напомнить снова");tap("+другое")
        ui.onAllNodesWithText("00").onFirst().performTouchInput { click() }
        Assert.assertEquals(EventState.ACKNOWLEDGED,event(e)?.state)
        Assert.assertNotNull(event(e)?.acknowledgedAt)
        Assert.assertFalse(FinalAlarmSignalPlayer.isActive(e))
        closeAlarm()
        text("Выберите будущее время!")
        Assert.assertEquals(EventState.ACKNOWLEDGED,event(e)?.state)
        Assert.assertNotNull(event(e)?.acknowledgedAt)
        Assert.assertFalse(FinalAlarmSignalPlayer.isActive(e))
        val warning=ui.onNodeWithText("Выберите будущее время!")
        warning.performScrollTo()
        val bounds=warning.fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
        val pixels=ui.onRoot().captureToImage().toPixelMap()
        var orange=0
        for(y in bounds.top.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0) until bounds.bottom.toInt().coerceAtMost(pixels.height))
            for(x in bounds.left.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0) until bounds.right.toInt().coerceAtMost(pixels.width)) {
                val c=pixels[x,y]
                if(c.red>.8f && c.green<.6f && c.blue<.15f) orange++
            }
        Assert.assertTrue("Past-time warning must be visibly orange, not semantics alone: $orange",orange>500)
        screenshotEvidence("custom-clock-past-warning")
    }
